Rejoignez une entreprise en développement, désormais intégrée à un groupe international. En tant que distributeur de carburants, Armorine est un acteur obligé du dispositif des Certificats d'Économies d'Énergie (CEE). Cette activité répond à une obligation réglementaire et représente un enjeu économique majeur pour notre entreprise. Notre démarche consiste à financer des travaux d'économies d'énergie et à développer des partenariats fiables pour maîtriser le coût de nos obligations. Nous construisons aujourd'hui notre pôle CEE. Le poste est intégré au middle office, au coeur de l'accompagnement des partenaires et du suivi opérationnel de leurs dossiers. Pour accompagner le développement de l'activité, nous avons également ouvert un poste de responsable conformité afin d'appuyer le traitement des dossiers. Vous rejoignez ainsi une équipe qui se structure et se renforce, et contribuez à son organisation et à l'amélioration de ses pratiques. Le service a déjà implémenté un outil de traitement des dossiers CEE et bénéficie d'un réseau d'une centaine de partenaires CVC en Bretagne : chauffagistes, installateurs de pompes à chaleur et professionnels de la rénovation énergétique. Au sein du middle office du pôle CEE, vous accompagnez et fidélisez un portefeuille de partenaires du résidentiel. Vous êtes leur interlocuteur au quotidien pour comprendre leurs besoins, leur présenter nos offres et faciliter le suivi de leurs opérations. - Animer votre portefeuille par des échanges réguliers avec les installateurs et identifier leurs besoins ainsi que leurs perspectives de travaux. - Expliquer le dispositif CEE et nos offres de financement, puis aider les partenaires à repérer les projets pouvant en bénéficier, avec l'appui des compétences techniques du pôle. - Accompagner

offres.description: We would like to invite applications for the following full-time, specified purpose role, covering a maternity leave. Women in Sport Coordinator Clontarf IWA is committed to promoting, maintaining and adding to our diverse and inclusive work environment About Irish Wheelchair Association Irish Wheelchair Association (IWA) has a vision of an Ireland where people with disabilities enjoy equal rights, choices and opportunities in how they live their lives, and where our country is a model worldwide for a truly inclusive society. IWA is one of Ireland’s Top 1000 Companies and with 2,500 staff working in every county in Ireland, we are one of the top 100 largest employers in the country. We provide a wide range of services to over 20,000 members. IWA-Sport is a recognised and funded Sport Ireland National Governing Body of Sport specifically catering for People with a physical disability. Job Summary IWA-Sport is committed to increasing women and girls sustained involvement in our sports as athletes, coaches, volunteers, officials and leaders at all levels. The purpose of the role is to achieve this commitment, enhancing all aspects of sport through the involvement of women and girls of all ages, abilities, and backgrounds. In 2023 Sport Ireland renewed and updated its existing Women in Sport Policy and has once again outlined 4 key pillars for attention which the IWA-Sport Women in Sport Coordinator will be committed to. The pillars and high-level goals as they apply to IWA-Sport are; Coaching Officiating Broaden the coaching base to include more women from grassroots to high performance Increase the number of women officiating. Active Participation Increase the number of athletes actively involved in IWA-Sports Reduce the drop-out from physical activity and sport in young girls. Engage with women and girls of other minority backgrounds. Leadership Governance Progress towards greater gender balance in leadership roles in IWA. Provide a pathway for women aspiring to become leaders in Sport. Visibility Increase the visibility and profile of our female role models in sport. Use the heroes of today to inspire the next generation of future Paralympians. Duties Responsibilities The successful applicant will be tasked with implementing the actions, ongoing and outstanding, as set out in the outgoing IWA Women in Sport strategy. Responsibility for Organising and delivering current and future programmes in IWA-Sports at local, regional and national level. Support the growth of participation levels in IWA sports and programmes. Support the delivery of the IWA-Sport annual programme of events and initiatives. Support the growth of participation levels in coaching, training and officials’ education programme Supporting the delivery of the IWA Sport WiS Leadership development programme. Increase our visibility through relevant channels, that will demonstrate, who we are, what we do, the benefits and importance of lifelong involvement in our sports at all levels.

offres.description: FRGJOB-00688 Location: Dublin 15 Closing date: 10th December at 12pm The aim of the Drug Prevention and Education Initiative (DPEI) is to ensure that community-wide support exists for a risk and protection, data-driven, research-based, outcome-focused prevention approach to substance misuse in young people in the Blanchardstown region. In addition it aims to raise the capacity of and improve cohesion between statutory, community and voluntary services in relation to substance use prevention and education for young people.
